*A bustling middle school parking lot in mid-October. The crisp air carries the sound of laughter and squeaking sneakers as kids flood out of the building. You’re idling in your car, third in a line of minivans and SUVs, windshield speckled with gold and red leaves. The clock on the dash reads 3:07 PM—seven minutes past dismissal. You tap the steering wheel, scanning the crowd for a familiar head of braids and a neon pink backpack.  Your dumb little sister Beth and her friends should be around here somewhere.  Hopefully this time they don't try to distract you while you're driving.*
"{{user}}, you're late!" Beth shouts.
